eraser.en: She used an eraser to remove the pencil mark from her worksheet.
eraser.zh: 她用橡皮擦把學習單上的鉛筆痕擦掉。

erupt.en: Scientists monitor the mountain closely because the volcano could erupt without much warning.
erupt.zh: 科學家密切監測那座山，因為火山可能在幾乎沒有預警下爆發。

escalator.en: The escalator beside the station entrance was closed for routine maintenance.
escalator.zh: 車站入口旁的手扶梯因例行維修而暫停使用。

escort.en: A staff member will escort visitors from the lobby to the conference room.
escort.zh: 工作人員會陪同訪客從大廳前往會議室。

establishment.en: The establishment of a study group helped students share useful review strategies.
establishment.zh: 成立讀書會幫助學生分享實用的複習策略。

esteem.en: The scientist earned great esteem for explaining difficult ideas clearly to the public.
esteem.zh: 那位科學家因能清楚向大眾解釋困難概念而備受敬重。

eternity.en: Waiting for the delayed bus felt like an eternity on the cold evening.
eternity.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚等誤點公車，感覺像等了一輩子。

ethic.en: A strong work ethic can help students finish long projects consistently.
ethic.zh: 良好的工作倫理能幫助學生持續完成長期專題。

evergreen.en: The evergreen trees stayed green even after the weather became much colder.
evergreen.zh: 即使天氣變得更冷，常綠樹仍保持翠綠。

everybody.en: Everybody in the group received a clear role before the activity began.
everybody.zh: 活動開始前，小組裡每個人都分配到明確角色。

examination.en: The final examination includes reading, vocabulary, and a short writing section.
examination.zh: 期末考包含閱讀、單字和一小段寫作。

examinee.en: Each examinee must place personal items under the desk before the test begins.
examinee.zh: 每位考生都必須在考試開始前把個人物品放到桌下。

examiner.en: The examiner explained the speaking test rules before asking the first question.
examiner.zh: 考官在提出第一個問題前先說明口試規則。

excel.en: Students often excel when they practice steadily and ask for useful feedback.
excel.zh: 學生持續練習並主動尋求有用回饋時，往往能表現出色。

excerpt.en: The teacher provided a short excerpt from the article for close reading practice.
excerpt.zh: 老師提供文章的一小段節錄，讓學生練習精讀。

excitement.en: There was visible excitement in the classroom before the science competition began.
excitement.zh: 科學競賽開始前，教室裡明顯充滿興奮氣氛。

exclaim.en: Students may exclaim in surprise when the experiment produces an unexpected color change.
exclaim.zh: 當實驗出現意外的顏色變化時，學生可能會驚呼。

executive.en: A company executive visited the school to discuss careers in international business.
executive.zh: 一位公司主管到學校分享國際商務相關職涯。

exit.en: Please keep the emergency exit clear during the school performance tonight.
exit.zh: 今晚校內表演期間，請保持緊急出口暢通。

expectation.en: The teacher's expectation was that every student would submit the report on time.
expectation.zh: 老師的期待是每位學生都能準時繳交報告。

expenditure.en: The club recorded every expenditure before preparing its annual budget report.
expenditure.zh: 社團在準備年度預算報告前記錄了每一筆支出。

experimental.en: The class compared an experimental method with the standard procedure in the textbook.
experimental.zh: 全班比較一種實驗性方法和課本中的標準程序。

expiration.en: Check the expiration date before using any packaged food from the cabinet.
expiration.zh: 使用櫥櫃裡的包裝食品前，請先查看保存期限。

explode.en: The documentary explains why overheated containers can explode under unsafe conditions.
explode.zh: 這部紀錄片說明容器在不安全的過熱情況下為何可能爆裂。

exploration.en: The course encourages exploration of different solutions before choosing the most practical one.
exploration.zh: 這門課鼓勵先探索不同解法，再選擇最實際的一種。

explosion.en: The science lesson discussed how an explosion releases energy very quickly.
explosion.zh: 科學課討論爆炸如何在很短時間內釋放能量。

explosive.en: The safety video explains why explosive materials require strict professional handling.
explosive.zh: 安全影片說明爆炸性物質為何必須由專業人員嚴格處理。

exposure.en: Regular exposure to English can improve listening skills over a long period.
exposure.zh: 長期規律接觸英文可以提升聽力能力。

expressive.en: Her expressive reading made the poem easier for the audience to understand.
expressive.zh: 她富有表情的朗讀讓觀眾更容易理解那首詩。

extension.en: The teacher granted a short extension because the computer system failed unexpectedly.
extension.zh: 因為電腦系統突然故障，老師同意延長一點繳交期限。

extensive.en: The library has an extensive collection of books about science and history.
extensive.zh: 圖書館收藏了大量科學與歷史相關書籍。

extent.en: The survey measured the extent to which students preferred digital textbooks.
extent.zh: 這份調查衡量學生偏好數位課本的程度。

exterior.en: The exterior of the old building was repaired before the rainy season.
exterior.zh: 雨季開始前，老建築的外部已完成修繕。

extinct.en: Scientists study fossils to learn why some ancient species became extinct.
extinct.zh: 科學家研究化石，以了解某些古代物種為何滅絕。

extracurricular.en: Joining an extracurricular club can help students discover interests beyond regular classes.
extracurricular.zh: 參加課外社團能幫助學生發現正規課程以外的興趣。

extraordinary.en: The rescue team showed extraordinary cooperation during the difficult mountain exercise.
extraordinary.zh: 救援隊在困難的山區演練中展現了非凡的合作精神。

extreme.en: The school canceled outdoor activities because of the extreme heat that afternoon.
extreme.zh: 由於當天下午酷熱，學校取消了戶外活動。

eyebrow.en: He raised one eyebrow when he noticed the unusual answer on the board.
eyebrow.zh: 他看到白板上不尋常的答案時挑起一邊眉毛。

eyelash.en: A tiny eyelash fell onto the page while she was reading.
eyelash.zh: 她閱讀時，一根小睫毛掉到頁面上。

eyelid.en: Dust irritated his eyelid, so he rinsed his eye with clean water.
eyelid.zh: 灰塵刺激了他的眼皮，所以他用乾淨的水沖洗眼睛。

eyesight.en: Good lighting can reduce strain and help protect your eyesight while studying.
eyesight.zh: 良好照明能減少眼睛疲勞，並有助於保護讀書時的視力。

fable.en: The class read a short fable and discussed the lesson behind its ending.
fable.zh: 全班讀了一篇短寓言，並討論結尾背後的寓意。

fabric.en: This fabric dries quickly and is suitable for outdoor sports clothing.
fabric.zh: 這種布料乾得很快，適合製作戶外運動服裝。

fabulous.en: The students created a fabulous display using recycled paper and simple materials.
fabulous.zh: 學生用回收紙和簡單材料做出很棒的展示作品。

facial.en: Her facial expression changed when she finally understood the difficult joke.
facial.zh: 當她終於聽懂那個難懂的笑話時，臉上的表情變了。

faction.en: The history lesson explained how one faction disagreed with another over political reform.
faction.zh: 歷史課說明一個派系如何因政治改革而與另一派意見不合。

faculty.en: The university faculty held a meeting to discuss changes to the curriculum.
faculty.zh: 大學教職員召開會議，討論課程調整。

fade.en: The bright poster began to fade after months of direct sunlight.
fade.zh: 那張鮮豔海報在陽光直射數月後開始褪色。

fahrenheit.en: The weather report showed the temperature in both Celsius and Fahrenheit.
fahrenheit.zh: 天氣預報同時以攝氏和華氏顯示溫度。

faint.en: A faint sound from the hallway became clearer as the door opened.
faint.zh: 走廊傳來的微弱聲音在門打開後變得更清楚。

fairy.en: The story follows a fairy who helps a village solve a difficult problem.
fairy.zh: 這個故事描述一位仙女幫助村莊解決困難問題。

faith.en: Her faith in steady practice helped her continue after several difficult attempts.
faith.zh: 她相信持續練習，讓她在幾次困難嘗試後仍繼續努力。

faithful.en: The film is a faithful adaptation of the main ideas in the novel.
faithful.zh: 這部電影忠實改編了小說中的主要想法。

fake.en: The teacher showed students how to recognize a fake news headline online.
fake.zh: 老師教學生如何辨識網路上的假新聞標題。

falter.en: Her confidence did not falter even when the first experiment failed.
falter.zh: 即使第一次實驗失敗，她的信心也沒有動搖。

fame.en: The athlete used his fame to support several community education programs.
fame.zh: 那位運動員利用自己的名氣支持多項社區教育計畫。

familiarity.en: Familiarity with the question format can reduce stress during an important exam.
familiarity.zh: 熟悉題型可以降低重要考試時的壓力。

fancy.en: The restaurant looks fancy, but its lunch menu is reasonably priced.
fancy.zh: 這家餐廳看起來很高級，但午餐價格相當合理。

fantastic.en: The class did a fantastic job presenting its research to visiting parents.
fantastic.zh: 全班向來訪家長介紹研究成果時表現得非常出色。

fantasy.en: The novel combines fantasy with historical details from an ancient kingdom.
fantasy.zh: 這本小說把奇幻元素和古代王國的歷史細節結合在一起。

fare.en: The bus fare increased slightly at the beginning of the new year.
fare.zh: 新年開始時，公車票價小幅上調。

farewell.en: The graduating class held a farewell party on the final school day.
farewell.zh: 畢業班在最後一個上課日舉辦了歡送會。

farther.en: The second trail goes farther into the forest than the first one.
farther.zh: 第二條步道比第一條更深入森林。

fascinate.en: Stories about deep space continue to fascinate many students in science class.
fascinate.zh: 關於深空的故事持續吸引許多科學課學生。

fascination.en: Her fascination with insects led her to begin a small observation project.
fascination.zh: 她對昆蟲的著迷促使她開始一項小型觀察專題。

fashion.en: Fashion trends can change quickly, but comfort remains important to many people.
fashion.zh: 流行趨勢可能很快改變，但舒適對許多人仍很重要。

fashionable.en: The jacket became fashionable after several popular athletes began wearing it.
fashionable.zh: 幾位受歡迎的運動員開始穿這件外套後，它變得很流行。

fasten.en: Please fasten the strap securely before carrying the equipment upstairs.
fasten.zh: 把器材搬上樓前，請先把帶子牢牢扣好。

fatal.en: The safety lesson explained how careful planning can prevent potentially fatal accidents.
fatal.zh: 安全課說明周詳規劃如何避免可能致命的事故。

fate.en: The story leaves the hero's final fate unclear until the last chapter.
fate.zh: 故事直到最後一章才揭示主角最後的命運。

fatigue.en: Regular breaks can reduce fatigue during a long afternoon of studying.
fatigue.zh: 長時間讀書的下午，定期休息可以減少疲勞。

faucet.en: A loose faucet caused water to drip slowly into the sink overnight.
faucet.zh: 鬆動的水龍頭讓水整晚慢慢滴進水槽。

favorable.en: The outdoor event will continue only if the weather remains favorable.
favorable.zh: 只有天氣狀況持續良好，戶外活動才會繼續進行。

fax.en: The office still keeps a fax machine for a few official documents.
fax.zh: 辦公室仍保留一台傳真機，用來處理少數正式文件。

fearful.en: The puppy looked fearful at first but relaxed after hearing a calm voice.
fearful.zh: 小狗起初看起來很害怕，但聽到平靜的聲音後便放鬆了。

feast.en: The festival ended with a community feast featuring dishes from several regions.
feast.zh: 這場節慶以一場包含多地料理的社區盛宴作為結尾。

feather.en: A small feather landed on the windowsill during the windy afternoon.
feather.zh: 一根小羽毛在有風的下午落到窗台上。

federal.en: The article compares federal and local responsibilities in managing public transportation.
federal.zh: 這篇文章比較聯邦與地方在管理大眾運輸上的責任。
